title: Q&A: ask in a group and track the answers
what: Post a question in any group (tag the person asked with @name); the dashboard adds a #QA… code line so every answer joins one thread. "To ask / To ping / To settle" points sent to a group from a Give to AI Agent or Check vs BE session (the send button next to the point) with an @name get this code too, naming who is asked from the AI's label above the message (#QA_BE_… / #QA_PO_… / #QA_QC_…) so you can tell who confirmed; attaching an answer (not your own message) from such a thread to a session adds "PO confirmed" / "BE confirmed" / "QC confirmed" plus "Trace the codebase, then fix or refactor." to the session's prompt box: the AI tags the recipient by @username, or by name for someone without one (the copy button turns it into @Name). When the session was sent a message (attached in its prompt box, or Check vs BE on one answer), the send button posts the point as a reply to the latest attached message, in that message's group; if that message is already in a Q&A thread the reply joins it, no new code (Check vs BE on many topics at once still posts a new message). Each question message holds at most 3 points, one line each; more than 3 are split into messages of 3, each with its own send button; a single point left over joins the message before it (7 points: 3 + 4). Questions with a #QA code posted from an AI Agent / Check vs BE session also put that group on the Q&A follow list (My questions, unanswered reminders). The Q&A page lists threads by group, filters Awaiting answer / Answered / You asked, counts a thread as Answered only when the tagged person replies (Settings › Telegram can change this to anyone), reminds you when your question has gone unanswered past the threshold, and the AI sums up a thread's conclusion. A tag with a #QA… code, or sitting in a Q&A thread, shows only on the Q&A page, not again in To do / Today / the group's tags (and is not counted as unhandled); pinned ones stay in Pinned tags.

title: AI assistant on every page (⌘J)
what: On the Telegram side, ⌘J (Ctrl+J) opens the Briefing assistant in the right panel from any page: ask about the latest summary of every group without going to Briefing. On the YouTrack side, ⌘J opens an AI session about the open tickets in the current scope (at-risk and high-priority tickets first).
how: Press ⌘J (Ctrl+J on Windows)

title: A message's work trail
what: Under the message you are replying to there is a "Work trail" line: tickets mentioned in the message with their state, the AI Agent / Check vs BE sessions on this message, the Q&A thread, whether it has been answered. Click each step to go straight there; a session step with a result opens the result right below, with “Use as reply draft” (into the open reply box) and “Open session”.
